commands: kubectl get pods -n astronomy-shop | grep -v Running; kubectl get events -n astronomy-shop --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -15
cd /tmp; sleep 20; kubectl get pods -n astronomy-shop; kubectl get deploy -n astronomy-shop; kubectl rollout history deploy/product-catalog -n astronomy-shop; kubectl get cm -n astronomy-shop

cd /tmp; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -B2 -A8 '"defaultVariant"' | grep -E 'defaultVariant|^\s+"[a-zA-Z]+": \{' ; kubectl logs deploy/product-catalog -n astronomy-shop --tail=15; kubectl logs deploy/checkout -n astronomy-shop --tail=10
cd /tmp; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -n -A3 productCatalogFailure
cd /tmp; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | sed -n 25,40p

cd /tmp; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | sed '32s/"on"/"off"/' | kubectl replace -f - && kubectl rollout restart deploy/flagd -n astronomy-shop && kubectl rollout status deploy/flagd -n astronomy-shop; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | sed -n 32p
agent.summary:
The root cause was the `productCatalogFailure` feature flag, which was set to `"on"` in the `flagd-config` ConfigMap. That flag makes the product-catalog service fail on a specific product.

I changed its `defaultVariant` to `"off"` and restarted the `flagd` deployment so it loads the new config. The rollout finished and all pods were Running before and after the change. I didn't re-test the product pages or check product-catalog's logs after the fix, so I haven't confirmed the errors stopped.
